summary: Equity Bancshares filed an 8-K furnishing unaudited Frontier Holdings LLC financial statements for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 plus related MD&A, solely to satisfy SEC requirements tied to its Form S-4 for the pending Lincoln Bancorp transaction. The previously completed Frontier merger, effective January 1, 2026 under an August 29, 2025 reorganization agreement, is not the new event. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are stated. What to watch: the Lincoln Bancorp S-4 registration and associated regulatory clock, not this routine historical financial update.
